slide_intent: Use repeated words as a rhythm so viewers can perceive a change in message through sequence.
strategic_value: The IMMER-to-BESSER replacement can give DB a forceful verbal rhythm using type alone.
demonstration: Three stacked IMMER lines change sequentially into BESSER lines.
practical_value: Choose stacked keyword replacement when repetition contributes to the message and the words remain short.

content_islands.name: Initial stack
content_islands.spec: Place IMMER on three tightly stacked lines.

content_islands.name: Replacement
content_islands.spec: Change the lines in sequence to BESSER.

reference_purposes.Expression: Three stacked IMMER lines change sequentially into BESSER lines.
reference_purposes.Application: The source provides a playable demonstration of this repeatable sequence: Three stacked IMMER lines change sequentially into BESSER lines.
reference_purposes.Intent: Accompanying Typografie prose prioritizes legibility and uses simple staggered line movement to keep text lively and clear.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Expressive typography is suited to individual keywords, not whole sentences or text blocks.

ingredient.name: Expressive type motion
ingredient.role: Emphasize a short verbal message through lettering movement.
ingredient.application: Apply the expressive treatment to individual keywords.
ingredient.scope: Official DB new-design web guidance, undated live edition captured 2026-11-05; applies to the demonstrated motion context. The source excludes whole sentences and text blocks from this treatment.
